# Diagnostic Rules

One row per diagnostic code. The normative definition of each rule —
expected behavior, executable examples, decision history — is its
catalog entry under `catalog/diagnostics/`. Severity can be overridden
per rule via `ssl.diagnostics.rules`; suppressible rules honor
`@ssl-disable` comments (see docs/configuration/CONFIGURATION.md §5).
